text:
Maria G: Quick question re: model ingest handshake — can we make the validator async so runtime isn't blocked on full checks? Thinking fast smoke + async full validation. cc @Ajay @Tim

Ajay K: Short answer: yes, but we need a clear fingerprint + admit contract. If we loosen the ingest gate we risk a bad model briefly reaching live. Need rollback semantics.

Tim L: We have a tiny smoke harness today. Proposal: two-phase admit with explicit states in the model manifest (pending, canary, live, quarantined). Runtime consults manifest and applies routing rules.

infra-bot: CI: ingest-smoke passed for model "gpt-mini-202" (job 2041234590) :white_check_mark:

Olivia P: Runtime perf concern — checking the registry on every request is expensive. Suggest local cache (TTL + version) + invalidation webhook when manifest changes. Also include an admit_version field to prevent race conditions.

Maria G: Sketch of manifest additions:
```json
{
  "model_id": "gpt-mini-202",
  "fingerprint": "sha256:abc123...",
  "admit_status": "pending", // pending | canary | live | quarantined
  "admit_version": 5,
  "smoke_hash": "sha1:deadbeef",
  "full_validation_job": "val-2041234590"
}
```

Ajay K: Policy example (yaml):
```yaml
admit_policy:
  mode: canary
  canary_fraction: 0.01
  canary_duration: 3600 # seconds
  async_validation: true
  max_qps_for_pending: 5
```

Tim L: Canary flow idea: route X% of traffic to model while validation runs. Monitor latency, failure-rate, eval regressions (preconfigured eval set). Auto-promote if thresholds met, otherwise demote/quarantine.

Olivia P: Edge-case: cache staleness during a rollback can still serve bad model. Use admit_version in manifest + sequence token so runtime rejects older versions. Also add a short-lived circuit-breaker when a model is promoted to prevent instant ramp from misconfig.

Maria G: Action items:
1) API: add manifest fields + admit APIs (PUT /models/:id/admit)
2) Runtime: local cache + admit_version checks + circuit-breaker
3) Router: canary routing + qps caps for pending models
4) Validation: hook eval results into promotion rules + alerts
5) Docs + runbook for rollback

Volunteers? :raising_hand:

Ajay K: I'll own (1) + (2).

Tim L: I'll prototype (3) + gating metrics.

Olivia P: I'll implement invalidation webhook + update docs/runbook.

Maria G: SG. I'll file RFC follow-up and create the ticket list with owners & acceptance criteria. Thanks all. :tada:
